visual_brief.subject: MemGovern gives coding agents reusable lessons from GitHub fixes
verified_context: MemGovern turns GitHub issues, pull requests and patches into roughly 135,000 structured debugging records.
The agent searches and reads those records while working; retrieval adds token overhead.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Condensed reference records make past repairs retrievable; the image makes no claim about benchmark gains or guaranteed correctness.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: Loose blank paper records gathered into a compact stack of cards held by pale stone, an abstract compression and retrieval metaphor.
must_show: central focal forms that survive cover cropping

candidate_notes.A: Viable loose-record-to-card relationship; the right-heavy stack is less balanced in a centered square crop.
candidate_notes.B: Selected: central stone fold holds a clearly separated fan of cards with loose sheets beneath. The restrained terracotta disc and warm grain fit the references without claiming a benchmark result.
candidate_notes.C: Viable overhead compression metaphor; the broad spiral of loose sheets competes with the organized stack at thumbnail scale.

crop_review.article_desktop: 1200 x 514 centered 21:9 crop inspected. Outer upper stone and lower tip crop; the complete focal card fan and loose sheets remain readable.
crop_review.article_mobile: 359 x 202 centered 16:9 crop inspected; focal forms remain visible.
crop_review.thumbnail: 320 x 164 centered cover crop inspected; focal silhouette remains distinct.
crop_review.home_square: 260 x 260 centered square preview inspected. Outer stone, disc and paper edges crop; the central card fan remains visible.

golden_reference_comparison: Warm paper, fine supporting arcs, tactile stone and restrained terracotta match the inspected references. The central fold gives the cards sculptural editorial presence. The image is simpler than the reference architectures and remains an abstract retrieval-memory artifact, not a model-training or access-control mechanism.
contact_sheet_renderer: Pillow fallback with two golden references above three candidates. Canonical contact-sheet CLI was attempted and could not launch the missing Playwright Chromium. The official browser download had already failed with a truncated/non-ZIP payload during the previous batch; it was not retried. No repository code or validator was changed.

generation_metadata.review_type: Codex model visual self-review; no human sign-off
generation_metadata.regeneration_reason: The preview exposed an unsupported correctionNote field. Converting it to the existing corrections array changed story bytes; the decision CLI returned GENERATE / generation-key-mismatch. Three new candidates were generated against the corrected source.

Subject: MemGovern gives coding agents reusable lessons from GitHub fixes

Composition: Canonical: oblique still life of loose unmarked cream paper sheets gathered toward a compact stack of blank terracotta and pale index cards held between two sculptural stone bookends. One focal transition from loose sheets to organized cards.
Art direction: restrained contemporary editorial illustration with a quiet scientific or architectural sensibility. Deliberate geometry, fine supporting lines, subtle paper texture, one clear focal idea, physical materiality, spatial depth and hierarchy. Warm canvas #F3EBDD, paper #FAF6EE, near-black #171B1A, muted gray #575D5B, sparing terracotta #8A4B35. Match the inspected golden references: tactile stone, architectural depth, warm print-like grain. Not glossy stock photography.
Editorial presence is required: not a bare schematic, flowchart, wireframe, icon composition or minimalist architecture diagram. Fine technical lines may support the image but cannot carry it.
Object-fit cover requirement: keep all essential relationships in the central 60 percent, leave generous surrounding negative space so desktop, mobile and thumbnail crops preserve the idea.
No words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, interface elements, page header, footer, buttons, badges, charts with invented data, watermark, neon effects, robots, or generic glowing AI brains. Do not generate a headline or imitate a screenshot. Do not produce a bare schematic, flowchart, wireframe, icon composition, or minimalist architecture diagram.
